question: Should the Control UI adopt this new-session drag-and-drop parity and the paired policy of cancelling URL/text drops outside real text-entry controls?
rationale: The patch is focused and proof-backed, but it deliberately sets user-visible browser-default behavior and the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human acceptance decision.
